messages.author: ceae52738e98aa80
messages.subject: DTF error
parts:
Hi Phil, wondering if you have any insight on the meaning/potential cause of this error. Thank you,

Jeannie

> pa.age.cat1.dtf <- DRF(pa.age.cat1.model.unconstrained, draws = 1000, DIF=FALSE, plot=FALSE, theta_lim = c(-4,4)) 
Error: Invalid parameter set drawn too often

messages.author: ceae52738e98aa80
messages.subject: Re: DTF error
parts: Hi Phil, nevermind I figured it out. :) I realized that there were too few item responses in a few of the extreme response categories and it was causing wonky item parameter estimates for a few items. I collapsed some of the response categories to address this and now it's running fine. thanks!
